question.text: 'Himalaya PE Fund' (Cat II) has a target corpus of INR 600 crore. What is the minimum sponsor continuing commitment?

explanation.text: The Logic: Cat I/II: lower of 2.5% of corpus or INR 5 crore. 2.5% x INR 600 crore = INR 15 crore; INR 5 crore is lower. Binding floor = INR 5 crore. The Trap: INR 15 cr uses 2.5% straight. INR 30 cr uses 5% (Cat III). INR 60 cr uses 10%. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests both sides of the breakeven (INR 200 cr). Sponsor rule is different for Cat III.
